notes.title: V1.2.0 Update Notice – New Vehicle: Scooter, New Game Mode: Car Escape
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="taODubxLh8w;full"][/previewyoutube]


Hello everyone, the game Drive and Unwind has now been updated to new version V1.2.0



In this version, we’ve added a new vehicle: the scooter.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610176/ff7944c8c4b26a1344a1f90e73212c990500f0e8.png"]



The Game Mode feature offers a variety of gameplay options to choose from.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610176/c2a36734a79d417f475e72629f93d544d205d838.png"]

Currently, we offer a new game mode called **Car Escape**.

You can tap the gear icon in the top right corner to enter the level selection or restart the current level.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610176/b42e9409d054490f1a9f0525f7fd1cf19466a4cf.png"]

As the name suggests, Car Escape requires you to clear all the cars from the screen to complete the level.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610176/907c1b642f3c89a112ba0f47671307ab95271f32.png"]


We hope you enjoy this update, and we’ll see you next time!
